name: SN Wraith E-Cycle
description: A lightweight electric motorcycle with an exposed-frame design that shows off its engineering — carbon fiber skeleton, visible power cells, transparent cowling over the motor. The Wraith is a Tier 3 status motorcycle, affordable enough for ambitious mid-tier residents and stylish enough to not embarrass them. It's the vehicle of middle management, skilled tradespeople, and freelancers who've had a good year. Not as fast or quiet as the Phantom, but you can park it without worrying someone will kill you for it.
propulsion: Single electric motor, visible power cell array
common_usage: Mid-tier commuting, personal transport for skilled workers, weekend recreation.
story_hooks: The transparent cowling on a Wraith reveals that the power cell has been replaced with something that isn't manufactured technology
Wraith owners are being targeted by a thief who only steals a specific component — one that has a secondary function no one was told about
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Combat Exoskeleton Lite CEL-3
physical_description: The Wraith's skeletal carbon-fiber frame is exposed and purposeful, every strut and joint visible beneath rain-beaded transparent polymer panels. Vertically-stacked power cells glow faintly blue along the sides, their industrial geometry softened only by weathered grip tape and reinforced cable runs. The motor housing sits naked behind translucent cowling, revealing brushless coils and cooling fins—a motorcycle that wears its engineering like scars.
